source.request_title: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence and Continuous Improvement

objective: Implement MNCS environmental capability intelligence: connect authentic agent-session, diagnostics, resource, and compiler evidence to provenance-aware queryable projections that reveal actionable recurring environmental pressures, then verify and improve the observation-to-action loop.
working_principles: Use legitimate MNCS development activity as operational evidence; do not create synthetic agent benchmarks or efficiency scores.
Relate agent objectives, environmental capabilities, observations, pressures, implementation changes, verification, and later evidence through existing authoritative records and projections.
Preserve the difference between measured facts, derived values, hypotheses, unverified source declarations, and unavailable information.
Use compiler and language progress as both evidence of environmental limitations and a beneficiary of environmental improvement.
Preserve active campaign ownership and integrate independent work through the established repository and claim workflows.
success_conditions: Authentic agent-session, diagnostic, resource, and compiler evidence can be related to objectives and environmental subsystems through a bounded queryable projection.
Recurring pressure hypotheses retain inspectable provenance and are distinguished from isolated observations and causal conclusions.
A real pressure can be connected to a code change, independent verification, and subsequent observed behavior without claiming effectiveness before evidence supports it.
The environment can expose what it can support, what remains constrained, and which measurements or relationships remain unavailable.
authority_boundary: This charter records the user-directed campaign objective only. It grants no repository access, claim transfer, merge authority, or permission to bypass existing ownership and safety checks.
